Look at the image below. In 25 seconds, please speak into the microphone and describe in detail what the image is showing. You will have 40 seconds to give your response.
ITEM IMAGE
EXAMPLE ANSWER
This
image
presents
a
graph
of
sunrise
and
sunset
times
throughout
2016
for
Detroit
,
MI
,
plotted
against
the
day
of
the
year
.
Firstly
,
we
can
see
that
the
sunrise
times
start
late
at
7am
and
gradually
become
earlier
,
reaching
their
earliest
point
,
which
is
approximately
5
am
around
the
middle
of
the
year
before
becoming
later
again
.
Conversely
,
the
sunset
times
follow
an
opposite
trend
,
starting
early
at
4
pm
and
becoming
later
,
and
then
shifting
earlier
.
This
creates
a
significant
change
in
the
length
of
day
.
In
conclusion
,
the
graph
shows
that
the
longest
days
,
with
the
most
daylight
hours
,
occur
during
the
summer
months
.
In
contrast
,
the
shortest
days
,
with
the
least
sunlight
,
are
found
in
the
winter
.
